_note: Where every picture in the shop came from. packages/catalog/shop.json says how each is drawn and labelled; this file says who made it, with what, when and from which words, so that anybody who asks whether a picture is a photograph of a real product can be answered exactly. Kept apart from shop.json because that file is read into the storefront's bundle. scripts/check-boundaries.mjs holds every product and kit in shop.json to an entry here, and every entry to a file on disk under the size cap. It sits in a folder of its own rather than beside shop.json because scripts/emit-clinical-review-pack.mjs reads every top-level catalogue file for a protocol's id, and a prompt that describes a wound-care kit is not a contract that names the wound-care protocol.
madeBy: The storefront rebuild, on the founder's decision of 2 October 2026: AI-generated, photo-realistic, unbranded studio product photographs in one consistent style, each marked as an illustrative image.
processing: Each 1200×896 source was centre-cropped to 4:3 and resized with Pillow (Lanczos) to 960×720 WebP at quality 78 and 480×360 WebP at quality 76 for the web, and to 480×360 JPEG at quality 74 (iOS asset catalogue) and WebP at quality 72 (Android drawable-nodpi) for the phones. The sources were deleted after conversion.
reviewed: Every image was looked at full size before it was kept: no maker's name, logo or printed word appears on any of them. The digits on screens are generic. The glucose meter's screen shows the unit mmol/L, and the first-aid box carries a moulded cross, neither of which names anybody.
